Kayla (CS): Aurora renewal just queued. Procurement will only sign once we provide: (1) vendor-signed pen-test PDF, (2) SOC2 link, and (3) proof KMS rotation is scheduled. They also want invoice made out to 'Aurora Systems Ltd' and PO AU-4492.

Raj (Onboarding): We can schedule KMS rotation job immediately once their infra accepts the IAM invite. ETA: rotation scheduled within 48 hours after acceptance; can upload rotation job config to portal as evidence.

DocuSignBot: Envelope EN-77821 created by Ivy (Legal) for Aurora  Amendment + billing-entity addendum awaiting signature from "CFO - Aurora Systems Ltd"
Kayla (CS): Procurement also requested a named infra contact to accept the IAM role. Marco, can you ask them to confirm who that is?
Marco (AE): Asked for infra contact. Got reply: ops.contact@aurora-sys.co.uk (Rachel Ops). Re-sending IAM invite now.
Raj (Onboarding): IAM invite re-sent to Rachel. If she accepts today, I'll flip the KMS rotation schedule and upload the audit job config to the secure folder.
Ivy (Legal): Amendment uploaded to envelope EN-77821. Will wait for pen-test and VAT/registration docs. If all received and signed within 5 days we keep the promotional upsell credit; otherwise it reverts.
Kayla (CS): Thanks team. I'll watch for the upload and post artifacts here. Quick note: procurement accepts redacted pen-test (signature page intact). I'll nudge them now.
